newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis, Palestinians to meet regularly on trade.
newsitem.headline: Israelis, Palestinians to meet regularly on trade.

text.p: A group of Israeli executives meeting Palestinian Authority Industry and Trade Minister Maher al-Masri agreed to hold a regular forum on trade issues, the Federation of Israeli Chambers of Commerce said on Tuesday.

The forum, to be headed by al-Masri and federation chairman Danny Gillerman, will address Israeli concerns about a planned Palestinian ban on Israeli agents and importers bringing goods into Palestinian areas, the federation said.

The forum will also look into what Gillerman said were Palestinian debts to Israeli businesses amounting to hundred of millions of shekels, the federation said. The two sides will also share information and assistance.

Al-Masri said the Palestinian ban, which is due to go into effect January 1, would not be rescinded as the Israelis had sought, according to the federation. But he did promise to enforce it with flexibility and impose it gradually, it added.
There was no immediate comment from the Palestinan Authority.

The meeting, which took place at al-Masri's office in the West Bank town of Ramallah, was the first between the federation and the Palestinian Authority since Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing government took office last June.
